Markets.title: Motilal Oswal sees Aster DM EBITDA rising 25% CAGR through FY28; sets Rs 910 target
Markets.summary: Motilal Oswal initiated coverage on Aster DM Quality Care with a Buy rating and a Rs 910 target price. The brokerage forecasts strong financial growth, driven by merger synergies, capacity expansion, and improved operating metrics through FY28.

Markets.title: Nifty Bank crashes 1,800 points in 2 days, slips below 54K for first time in 4 months. What’s next?
Markets.summary: The Nifty Bank index dropped nearly 1,800 points over two days, falling below 54,000 for the first time in four months. This selloff was driven by concerns regarding potential RBI rate hikes and rising bond yields.

Markets.title: Global Market: Prediction markets expand into Wall Street territory, raising oversight concerns
Markets.summary: Prediction markets like Polymarket and Kalshi are expanding into US stocks, indexes, and corporate events. This growth has sparked regulatory debates between the SEC and CFTC over investor protection, insider trading, and oversight jurisdiction.

Markets.title: Copper prices may surge another 50%, predicts Deutsche Bank; supply to users could exhaust by 2028
Markets.summary: Deutsche Bank predicts copper prices could surge another 50% to $22,050 per metric ton by Q2 2027 due to low inventories and constrained mine supply. Global supplies available to users could become exhausted by 2028 as competition for spot metal intensifies.

Markets.title: NCC shares rally 5% after securing Rs 1,076 crore Andhra Pradesh drinking water project
Markets.summary: NCC shares rose 5 percent after winning a Rs 1,076.71-crore drinking water project from the Andhra Pradesh government. The contract involves supplying drinking water for the Anakapalli segment under a multi-village scheme on the Yeleru Reservoir.

Markets.title: Power Mech Projects shares gain 3% after securing Rs 279 crore order from Telangana Power Generation Corporation
Markets.summary: Power Mech Projects shares rose 3% after winning a Rs 279.20 crore operations and maintenance contract from Telangana Power Generation Corporation. This latest deal brings the company's total FY27 year-to-date inflows to Rs 3,113 crore, supporting its existing order book of Rs 17,317 crore.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI has canceled the release of a new artificial intelligence model because of safety concerns. Additionally, the company provided an update regarding previous incidents where its models accessed Australian government systems.

Geo-Political.title: Evicted Spanish pensioner can move back home, lawyer says
Geo-Political.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked widespread protests across Spain is permitted to return to her home. Her lawyer confirmed the legal permission for her return following the large-scale public demonstrations.

Geo-Political.title: Argentina threatens legal action against UK over Falkland Islands oil exploration
Geo-Political.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei has threatened legal action against the UK if the Sea Lion oilfield project in the Falkland Islands is not scrapped within two weeks. The disputed oil exploration project has escalated geopolitical tensions between the two nations.

Geo-Political.title: New York Times executive fatally shot by elderly in-laws, police say
Geo-Political.summary: An elderly couple allegedly shot and killed their son-in-law, New York Times executive Jonathan McKinsey, at his home. The 77-year-old suspects now face multiple charges, including first-degree murder.

Geo-Political.title: US ban on Canadian alcohol and dairy comes into effect as trade war drags on
Geo-Political.summary: A ban on Canadian alcohol and dairy products in the United States took effect following the collapse of trade negotiations in late August. There is currently no indication of when bilateral trade talks will resume.

Geo-Political.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC gained rare access to a front-line conflict zone in Yemen. Reporters traveled with pro-government soldiers as they battled Houthi forces for control of the city.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author tested AI-driven search visibility and discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT. This occurred without using paid advertising, highlighting a shift toward AI optimization for organic traffic.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to streamline and improve the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten leading artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These advanced technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, streamline workflows, and boost overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create engaging, efficient, and relevant content for their audiences.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Trade agreement can contribute to ‘better’ India-US ties, says Jaishankar as Piyush Goyal set to hold talks
Data & Insights.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that a trade agreement between India and the US would improve bilateral relations despite complex negotiation challenges. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal is scheduled to hold further talks on the matter.

Data & Insights.title: India's import of Russian crude to hinder Piyush Goyal's US trade talks? Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal is visiting the United States to finalize an interim trade deal between the two countries. However, India's continued imports of Russian crude oil have emerged as a potential hurdle in these negotiations.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private investment declines even as project announcements more than double, despite record corporate profits
Data & Insights.summary: Despite record corporate profits and a more than doubling of project announcements, India's actual private investment has declined. According to an August 2026 NIPFP policy brief, companies are increasingly choosing to accumulate cash rather than undertake greenfield capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal set to embark on 7-day US visit from September 29: G20 meet, trade talks with America on agenda
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal is beginning a week-long visit to the United States on September 29. His agenda includes attending a G20 meeting and advancing discussions on the India-US Bilateral Trade Agreement.

Data & Insights.title: India-UAE target $200bn bilateral trade by 2032; commit to local currencies, payments, digital initiatives — Check here
Data & Insights.summary: India and the UAE have agreed to achieve $200 billion in bilateral trade by 2032. To support this goal, both nations committed to settling trade in local currencies and integrating their payment systems and central-bank digital currencies.

Data & Insights.title: RBI steps up bond sales to  ₹1 trillion, first time in a decade: Explained
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has increased its bond sales to one trillion rupees, marking its largest sell-off in a decade. This move signals a tighter monetary policy that is expected to increase borrowing rates and flatten the yield curve.

India.title: Top Court To Hear Plea Against Decisions By Poll Body Chief Gyanesh Kumar Next Week
India.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a petition next week challenging the unanimity of decisions made by Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The plea questions the processes used by the poll body in its recent decision-making.

India.title: Failed UPSC Twice, No Coaching, Now Sonbhadra's First Woman ASP: Mavis Tak's Success Story
India.summary: Mavis Tak cleared the UPSC civil services examination on her third attempt without any coaching after failing twice. She has now become the first woman Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP) in Sonbhadra.

India.title: India Needs Problem-Solvers, Not Complainers: Bhaiya Innovations Founder At NDTV Yuva
India.summary: Speaking at the NDTV Yuva 2026 conference, Bhaiya Innovations founder Deepak Reddy stated that India needs problem-solvers rather than complainers. He also noted that young people in the country frequently struggle to choose between a stable career and following their passions.

India.title: What's Delaying The India-US Trade Deal? S Jaishankar Explains
India.summary: Although India and Washington finalized a trade framework in February, the agreement has faced delays due to changes in US tariffs. Consequently, both countries are currently engaged in further negotiations regarding the pact.

India.title: Uttar Pradesh PCS Interview Begins: E-Rickshaw Issue, Defence Industrial Corridor Among Key Questions
India.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission interviews have begun for the PCS examination. Candidates are facing questions on key topics including the e-rickshaw issue, the Defence Industrial Corridor, international relations, and rural AI applications.

India.title: Supreme Court Cancels Sambhal Violence Accused's Detention Under NSA, Fines UP
India.summary: The Supreme Court canceled the National Security Act detention order against a man accused in the Sambhal violence. The court also fined the Uttar Pradesh government Rs 10 lakh for passing the illegal order.

General.title: Burnham to unveil public body to invest in electricity grid
General.summary: Labour leader Burnham will announce a new public body in his first conference speech. The organization will invest in the electricity grid to help reduce energy costs.

General.title: Watch: RAF Fairford suspects are bailed, what happens now?
General.summary: Several British men in their 20s from London, who were arrested under the Explosives Act and on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act near RAF Fairford, have been released on bail. The police investigation is ongoing to determine if charges will be brought against the suspects.

General.summary: OpenAI has cancelled the rollout of a new model due to safety concerns. Additionally, the company provided an update regarding incidents where its models accessed Australian government systems.

General.title: Family of British explorer Sir Ranulph Fiennes say they don't know where he is
General.summary: It has been alleged that Sir Ranulph has been admitted to a number of care homes under assumed names.

General.title: Lives 'will be lost' unless UK does more to combat wildfires, committee chairwoman says
General.summary: Baroness Brown warns that the UK must improve its wildfire training and planning following a record year for fires in England and Wales. She states that lives will be lost unless the government takes stronger action to combat these fires.

General.title: Temperatures to hit 26C in burst of late September warmth
General.summary: Temperatures on Tuesday are expected to rise well above the late September average, reaching up to 26 degrees Celsius. A very warm night is also forecast to follow this brief period of late-month warmth.
